messages:
rita: quick thought  what if we surface a per-tenant "notify spend guard" in the console so teams can set soft/hard monthly budgets for alerting and get automated attenuation when spend approaches limit?

max: could be great for customers watching billing. is this for token spend only or includes paging/email costs?

chris: prefer to start with token spend (notify API egress) and leave channel-specific billing for later. keep the first iteration simple.

nina: UX ask  need clear signals: projected burn rate, days-to-exhaust, and a preview of which routes would be throttled first. owners must not be surprised.

rita: implementation sketch: 1) budget object: {window, soft_threshold_pct, hard_threshold_pct, action_on_soft, action_on_hard} 2) actions can be: notify_preview (reduce fanout), sample, mute_non_critical_routes, fallback_model.

max: show example payload?

rita: pasted example:```json
{
  "tenant_id": "acct_99",
  "budget_window": "monthly",
  "currency": "tokens",
  "soft_threshold_pct": 70,
  "hard_threshold_pct": 95,
  "soft_action": {"mode":"attenuate","fanout_ratio":0.5},
  "hard_action": {"mode":"sample","rate":0.1}
}
```

chris: couple infra notes: 1) this needs a cheap estimator to compute projected burn from current velocity (moving avg) 2) avoid race windows where many alerts fire and budget flop. probably use a token bucket per-tenant and atomic check in notify router.

nina: and on console surface: burn chart (hourly), predicted exhaustion date, last triggered action and list of affected SLOs. also a one-click "lift guard for active incident" button so operators can opt out.

max: legal/product: we can't silently change SLA behavior. soft action should be advisory by default with explicit opt-in for enforce. default mode: preview + email to owners when crossing soft threshold.

rita: yes default to preview. telemetry fields proposed: "budget_window", "current_burn_pct", "predicted_exhaust_ts", "applied_action", "affected_slos". send to billing-telemetry and alerts-telemetry streams.

chris: API compatibility: POST /v1/tenants/:id/notify-budget. validation rules: pct in [1,100], actions must be known enum, fanout_ratio in (0,1]. Also a field "enforce_after_preview_days" integer.

rita: sample GET for preview: `GET /v1/tenants/:id/budget/preview?horizon=72h` returns a small summary: original_estimate, estimate_with_budget, routes_ranked_by_savings.

nina: front-end note: when editing a budget, show a diff of "what changes" and a simulated incident to demonstrate behavior. that helps approvals.

max: ops: need dashboards. infra-bot can you create INF-8321 to add panels: tenant_budget_burn_pct, budget_actions_fired, predicted_exhaust_ts histogram?

infra-bot: INF-8321 created: "Notify Spend Guard dashboards". tagged ops and billing.

chris: edge cases: multi-tenant shared routes (org-level pipelines)  how to attribute spend? attribute by origin tenant id embedded in notify request; if missing, count to org pool. need fallbacks.

rita: also want owner notification policy: send initial email when budget created, and throttled digest when soft_action first applied. include quick links to lift or extend.

nina: accessibility: charts should have a table fallback w/ key numbers. and make the lift button gated by 2FA for enterprise.

max: rollout plan: feature flag + preview-only for internal tenants for 10 days, then opt-in for customers, then auto-suggest budgets for high-spend tenants.

rita: follow-ups: I'll draft RFC + validation spec. chris, can you outline router atomic check? nina, can you mock the UI diff + simulated incident?

chris: will do. sketch: local token bucket + compare to budget threshold then atomically apply per-request decision; emit event for telemetry.

nina: starting mocks now. will include warning states and enforcement wave.

max: small nit: include "grace credits" for first-week-of-month to avoid accidental immediate throttles for monthly budgets. default grace = 5% or 48h window.

rita: add `grace_credits` to the payload by default. good catch.

infra-bot: INF-8321 updated with grace_credits note and telemetry fields.

max: thanks all. RFC when ready. :party-blob:
